en: A reported prologue run is still not a PC game

PC Games Hardware says a project named ZETTROX can steer Lucia through the prologue on a GeForce RTX 3050, at single-digit frame rates. PC Gamer’s same-day update says shader work on AMD hardware is also single-digit, and that GTA 6 does not run on PC.
zh: 有报道的序章试跑，仍不是 PC 游戏
PC Games Hardware 称，名为 ZETTROX 的项目能在 GeForce RTX 3050 上以个位数帧率操控露西亚走过序章。PC Gamer 同日更新写道：AMD 显卡上的着色器进展同样是个位数帧，GTA 6 在 PC 上还不能玩。

sources.title: GTA 6: PC-Ports erreichen den Prolog, Take-Two greift durch
The race to port GTA 6 to PC, explained

en: Take-Two’s DMCA notice removes the Leonida network

GitHub published a notice dated 24 Nov from Take-Two. heise, The Verge and ComputerBase report that the block covers Leonida and 3,007 repositories in that network. The notice is about that network, not a PC version of the game.
zh: Take-Two 的 DMCA 通知移除了 Leonida 网络
GitHub 公开了 Take-Two 日期为 11 月 24 日的通知。heise、The Verge 和 ComputerBase 报道，封锁覆盖 Leonida 及其网络中的 3007 个仓库。这份通知针对的是那个网络，不是官方 PC 版。

sources.title: Take-Two gets unofficial PC port removed from GitHub
GTA VI PC recompilation project shut down by Take-Two
DMCA-Beschwerde: GitHub erklärt Takedown der GTA-VI-Rekompilierung Leonida

en: VIctory and XCL load the game world
PC Games Hardware reported that both already load the world. A separate clip of a lit scene at about 3 fps is still unconfirmed.
zh: VIctory 和 XCL 能加载游戏世界
PC Games Hardware 报道这两个项目已经能加载世界。另有一段约 3 帧的亮场景片段，仍未证实。

sources.title: GTA 6 auf dem PC: Leonida ist offline, VIctory und XCL laden schon die Spielwelt

en: Leonida disappears, a day before the DMCA notice
Repository and Discord vanished on 23 Nov. The founder said Rockstar had the Discord removed. Take-Two’s DMCA notice was published the next day.
zh: Leonida 在 DMCA 通知公开的前一天消失
仓库和 Discord 在 11 月 23 日消失。创始人称 Discord 是 Rockstar 申请删的。Take-Two 的 DMCA 通知次日公开。

en: Cyberleek releases the missing EXE
Outlets describe a ZIP of about 57 MB. It is the Xbox program file, not a PC version. heise reported that menus appeared within hours, and that the game was not playable.
zh: 大葱哥（Cyberleek）放出缺失的 EXE
媒体描述为一个约 57 MB 的 ZIP。那是 Xbox 版的主程序，不是 PC 版。heise 报道数小时内出现了菜单，但游戏不能玩。

sources.title: After executable leak, modders work on unofficial GTA 6 PC port

en: First console patch, 1.002.002
Reported by heise. The leaked build (1.0.2.1) is now out of date.
zh: 主机版首个补丁 1.002.002
heise 报道。泄露版本（1.0.2.1）已经过时。

en: Cyberleek cuts its meme-coin target
The EXE was promised at a $15M market cap, cut to $6M. Neither was reached.
zh: 大葱哥下调迷因币目标
原定币市值到 1500 万美元就放 EXE，后降到 600 万，都没达到。

en: GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
No PC version. Rockstar says the game plays best on PS5.
zh: GTA 6 登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S
没有 PC 版。Rockstar 称 PS5 体验最好。

en: 209 GB Xbox build leaks on launch day
Version 1.0.2.1, shipped without its executable, so it could not start.
zh: 发售当天 209 GB Xbox 版泄露
版本 1.0.2.1，缺主程序，无法启动。

en: Take-Two DMCA hits GTA 5 ports on GitHub
TorrentFreak reported that mobile and web ports of GTA 5 were named in takedown notices the day before GTA 6 launched.
zh: Take-Two 对 GitHub 上的 GTA 5 移植发起 DMCA
TorrentFreak 报道，GTA 6 发售前一天，一批 GTA 5 手机版和网页版移植出现在下架通知里。

sources.title: Take-Two targets hundreds of GTA V mobile ports on GitHub ahead of GTA VI launch

en: Digital Foundry: PS5 Pro is the best way to play
Near-locked 30 fps and a near-4K image. 60 fps is held back by the CPU.
zh: Digital Foundry：PS5 Pro 体验最好
几乎稳定 30 帧，画面接近 4K。60 帧卡在 CPU 上。

en: Fake “GTA 6 EXE” spreads the WARDEN stealer
A Google Colab link leads to a ZIP that steals passwords, Steam logins and crypto wallets.
zh: 假“GTA 6 EXE”传播 WARDEN 盗号木马
Google Colab 链接指向一个 ZIP，会盗取密码、Steam 账号和加密钱包。

en: GamesBeat: PC version targeted for Q1 2027
Four unnamed sources. Rockstar did not comment.
zh: GamesBeat：PC 版目标 2027 年 Q1
4 个匿名信源，Rockstar 未回应。

en: Development footage leaks
Cyberleek posts clips it says date from 2023. Take-Two responds with DMCA takedowns.
zh: 开发版视频泄露
大葱哥放出据称 2023 年的开发片段，Take-Two 随即发 DMCA。

en: Pre-orders open, consoles only
No PC listing on any store.
zh: 开启预购，仅限主机
任何 PC 商店都没有上架。
